description: Write the edit for another editor: fcpxml (Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve), otio (Premiere, Resolve, OpenTimelineIO apps), edl (CMX 3600, one video track), or srt/vtt (the captions). Best effort: warnings lists what the format could not carry (masks, blend modes, effects, animated transforms, ramps, text styling). timeline.get is the lossless copy. media collect makes a .zip with the media files next to the timeline file. Long-running: a task, or {job_id} for job.get; the result has a signed download URL.

filename.description: Output file name without extension. Default: timeline name and id

format.description: fcpxml: Final Cut Pro, Resolve; otio: Premiere, Resolve, any OTIO app; edl: CMX 3600; srt/vtt: captions

media.description: reference: point at the media where it is; collect: a .zip with the media in it

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

name: export.timeline

file.description: Where it was written in the exports folder (local mode)

warnings.description: What the format could not carry

job_id.description: Job handle; the same value is the MCP task id

media_id.description: The media it is making; usable in edits once processing

title: Export timeline
